result: While a large GeoJSON or GeoJSON sequence is read, both area maps draw the outlines read so far as a dashed, unfilled, unpicked preview from the read-preview route, with the route's words beside the map.

limits.capWords: The preview shows the first 20,000 outlines read.

behaviour.paging: after=-1, then after=next; a full page is read again at once, otherwise every 2 s while reading; stops when reading ends or the cap is reached.
behaviour.basis: A new crsBasis drops the drawn set and reads again from after=-1; unsupported draws nothing and shows the route's words.
behaviour.removal: Removed when the item's placement becomes on_map (its first package), when it leaves the batch or its state leaves probed/planned/reading, or when the route says sealed and not reading.
behaviour.frame: Longitude and latitude placed as the imagery overlay does: the area's WGS 84 UTM zone (EPSG:326xx/327xx) minus its origin; any other frame draws nothing and says so.
behaviour.style: Scene setPreviewOutlines: one LineDashedMaterial set in --ui-seq-550 at the surface lift, no fill, no height, raycast off, so no pick, inspector or measurement.
behaviour.geometry: Polygons and multipolygons only; points and lines are counted and named as not drawn, since the scene draws neither.

inputs.use: test_only; first three geometries as the fake route's pages

readPreview.test.ts.covers: three fetches after -1, 1, 2 then no polling; drawn ids and coordinates equal the outlines returned; rfc7946 to stated replaces; unsupported draws none with words; on_map and sealed remove; 20,000 cap and point words

pnpm studio:typecheck.cause: known table-placement-command.ts:65 until S5.7b; none from this task

ui-design-check scan.judgement: palette.ts token fallback and a test palette value, both the existing pattern; no issue

next: Points and lines are not drawn in the preview because the scene draws neither; drawing them needs a scene line and pin layer.
At the 20,000 cap polling stops, so a later crsBasis change is not seen until the file's first package replaces the preview.
